about:
# XPIsland

💾 **[Download the latest version](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/xpisland) on CurseForge**

A compact XP bar for World of Warcraft: Forever, inspired by Dynamic Island.

- Track rested XP, XP remaining and estimated time to level.
- Expand for session XP sources, pet XP, PvP rank and estimated kills to level.
- Track the faction marked **Show as Experience Bar** in your Reputation panel, including at max level. Select Reputation in Tracking settings or by right-clicking the island’s value label.
- Track Honor and Rank Points in PvP mode, including at level cap. Enable it in Tracking settings or opt into switching at level cap.
- Choose Modern or WoW Forever themes, shared or character profiles, fonts and scale. The island fits your UI and stays compact on ultrawide screens.
- Hide Blizzard's XP, reputation and Honor bars. Other addons keep control of their bars.

![xp-island-collapsed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b241fb90-beaf-42a0-8e35-8fb6bc308707)

## Installation

Copy `XPIsland` into your Forever client's `Interface/AddOns` folder, then restart WoW. `XPIsland.toc` must be directly inside `XPIsland`.

Right-click the value label to choose Experience, Honor & PvP or Reputation; each has a submenu of label formats.

Use `/xpisland` for settings and `/xpisland reset` to reset session stats. Click the island to expand or collapse it, or bind “Expand / collapse XPIsland” in WoW's Keybindings.

## Contributing

Open an issue before submitting a PR. Unsolicited PRs may be closed.

## Development

Run the checks in [Check addon](https://github.com/elithrar/XPIsland/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml) from the repository root with LuaJIT and Python 3. Create `dist/` before running Lua tests. `python3 tests/package.py` builds a local ZIP in `dist/`.

See [behavior details](https://github.com/elithrar/XPIsland/blob/main/docs/BEHAVIOR.md) and [validation coverage](https://github.com/elithrar/XPIsland/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md), including API contract checks and historical client observations.

releases.name: XPIsland v0.7.11
releases.notes:
XPIsland 0.7.11 for World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001).

- Fix startup stopping after the island appears when the client declines a duplicate event registration. XP updates, kill estimates and the /xpisland command can now initialize.
- Report the name of any event the client refuses and continue registering the remaining events.
- Retry a pending reward on the existing timer when the first XP read is stale.

releases.name: XPIsland v0.7.10
releases.notes:
XPIsland 0.7.10 for World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001).

- Bundle SomethingNeedDoing 0.5.3 with fixes for stale settings callbacks and screen containment recovery.
- Cancel an active island drag when switching to or copying the same profile, even when its settings are unchanged. Delayed drag-stop callbacks cannot overwrite the replacement placement.
- Discard old color edits, dropdown selections and replacement confirmations after profile changes, including an already-default reset.
- Preserve existing profiles, character assignments, XP accounting and session data.

Validation: full workflow Lua suite and pinned Forever API checks, release guards and addon-only package checks. Added equal-value profile gesture regressions fail with the previous bundled framework and pass with 0.5.3. Native rendering, physical input, combat/taint and coexistence remain unobserved in-game checks.

releases.name: XPIsland v0.7.9
releases.notes:
XPIsland 0.7.9 for World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001).

- Show the watched faction’s name in the reputation header, such as `Stormwind · 31.9%`, across percentage, current/total, remaining, maximum and reward-ready displays.
- Shorten long faction names with an ellipsis while preserving the full progress value, chosen font size and usable bar width. The hover keeps the complete name.

Validation: the full workflow Lua suite, pinned Forever API checks, release guards and addon package validation. Focused reputation checks cover watched-faction changes, UTF-8 names, both themes, label formats, font sizes, fractional scales and expansion. Native rendering of the corrected label remains an in-game check.

releases.name: XPIsland v0.7.8
releases.notes:
XPIsland 0.7.8 for World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001).

- Add Reputation mode in Tracking settings and the value label’s right-click menu. It follows the faction marked Show as Experience Bar in the native Reputation panel and stays visible at max player level.
- Add label-format submenus for Experience, Honor & PvP and Reputation. Mode and format choices persist per profile without resetting XP sessions.
- Show faction, standing, reputation progress and remaining reputation, with exact hovers and explicit no-selection, maximum and paragon-reward states. Support ordinary, renown, friendship and paragon reputations.

Validation: full workflow Lua suite, including watched reputation and nested menu regressions against the pinned Forever API source, offline release guards and local package checks. Native submenu input/rendering, server event timing and combat/taint still require in-game verification.

releases.name: XPIsland v0.7.7
releases.notes:
XPIsland 0.7.7 for World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001).

- Fix slash-command taint that could block protected Blizzard commands such as `/pvp` with `ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN` attributed to XPIsland.
- Bundle SomethingNeedDoing 0.5.2, preserving Blizzard's existing slash-command registry and changing only XPIsland's own entries.
- Add startup and logout regression coverage for native slash-command ownership.

Automated checks cover the unsafe global assignment, addon startup, slash-command handling, cleanup and package integrity. Native combat/taint behavior still requires in-game verification.
